API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIOrganization DetailsOrganization Information Resource Get Organization Information
Organization Information Resource Get Organization Information
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/orgInformation

Retrieves detailed organization information, including headquarter location, geolocation, address, and contact details.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)

alertTimer
string

Time after which the alert is resend if condition is not cleared. If not set, the default value of 30 minutes is considered.

Possible values: [MINUTES_30, HOUR_1, HOURS_6, HOURS_12, HOURS_24]
